note: Every Bible quotation is the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB, 2017, © Biblica, CC BY-SA 4.0; the ebible mirror lug_bib), pasted by script and checked as a substring of the cited verse (mined) — or rendered by the translator where the English re-persons, abridges or reworks a verse, or where OLCB's sense contradicts the author's point (self_rendered). The English edition quotes the Open Word Bible (OWB); where the author's prose leans on an OWB word OLCB lacks, the Luganda prose was adapted to OLCB's wording.

Classic-author quotations (Murray, Bounds, Moody, Spurgeon) are pasted verbatim from the library's Luganda editions where one exists; Bounds's The Reality of Prayer, Torrey's How to Pray, Watson's The Lord's Prayer, Müller and Bunyan have none and were translated in-session. AI-translated; awaiting native review.
